reviewed_source: repository candidate; exact commit is bound by its PR

policy.temporary: TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP, Python bytecode and Wrangler logs are job-owned; built-in job lifecycle handles hard-kill leftovers subject to permissions.
policy.retained: Builds, qualification bundles, encrypted backups and evidence keep their existing artifact paths and retention.
policy.caches: Existing npm/pip/tool caches and explicit action/Trivy caches remain persistent; no host-wide sweep or prune.
policy.shared_lock: scripts/ci/self-hosted/host-port-lock.sh deliberately keeps the stable /tmp/clued-ci-NAME.lock inode for cross-runner flock; a tiny coordination file, not transient extraction data. G4 also keeps /tmp/clued-g4-docker-<daemon-hash>.lock through scripts/ci/clued-g4-fresh-start.mjs: a stable tiny flock inode only for qualified native runners sharing the same Docker daemon and /tmp filesystem; an equal daemon ID across separate mounts does not establish coordination. The kernel releases the startup lock when its last owning descriptor closes.
policy.vendor_bootstrap: Official checkout/setup-node/setup-python/cache/upload-artifact actions manage workspace, tool cache and runner temporary transfers; they may run before repository bootstrap.

.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage/act.scope: Validates the job directory; exports environment only; removes its own exclusive write probe; never sweeps other jobs.

windows-route.reason: Only compares the assigned runner name and emits a route observation; no checkout, subprocess or filesystem writer.

linux-route.reason: Only compares the assigned runner name and emits a route observation; no checkout, subprocess or filesystem writer.
